hero.subtitle: Seamlessly access, manage, and distribute product and category data via isolated API keys. A modern SaaS architecture inspired by OpenRouter.

workflow.title: Three Simple Steps to Integrate Your API
workflow.subtitle: Built for developers: go from account creation to consuming RESTful endpoints in minutes.
workflow.step1Desc: Sign up for a seller account to get a JWT token. This token is used to manage your account and securely generate API Keys.
workflow.step2Desc: Create one or multiple API Keys labeled specifically for your web apps, mobile apps, or third-party integrations.
workflow.step3Desc: Attach your key in the x-api-key header to perform Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations on your catalog data.
workflow.visualDesc: JWT protects your administrative dashboard, while API Keys grant programmatic data access without exposing your master login credentials.

features.title: Engineered for Seamless Integration
features.subtitle: A robust Express.js + PostgreSQL backend paired with an intuitive developer interface.
features.feat1Desc: Full control over your access keys: generate new keys, copy with one click, inspect last used timestamps, or revoke access anytime.
features.feat2Desc: Manage thousands of items with category filtering, SKU/title search, availability status, weight, and blazing fast pagination.
features.feat3Desc: Test every endpoint directly in the browser via an interactive sandbox console without switching to external apps like Postman.
features.feat3Point2: Real-time response with HTTP status codes
